card.capacity_status_quote: Our focus is on execution and ensuring we capitalize on this strong demand by having more than enough capacity in place to support our customers while we work on the challenges in the supply chain.
card.demand_direction_quote: Underlying datacom demand remains exceptionally strong. In fact, demand during the quarter far exceeded what we were able to ship
card.guidance_direction_quote: we expect total revenue to be in the range of $1.250 billion to $1.290 billion, representing year-over-year growth of approximately 40% at the midpoint
card.constraint_owner_quote: we saw a broadening of supply shortages for components and materials for datacom products, and as a result, shipments and revenue were well below demand levels. We could have shipped a lot more if we had those components.
